jobs.description: 산업입지정보시스템(ILIS) 산업단지 목록·고시 목록·상세, the address source of silver.industrial_complexes (root ADR-0033; scripts/ops/industrial-complex-address-source-collect.sh, the publisher's collect-industrial-complex-address-source): the complex list (il/danji/list.do) and the notice list (il/danref/list.do) in one request each, then one detail request (il/danji/det/info.do) for each complex of the newest vworldkr__sandan_profile workbook in Bronze that the list does not carry (four of 1,442 measured 2026-08-16), two seconds between requests, the count checked against the run's ceiling before the requests it counts. Each answer lands in Bronze once (write-once, deduplicated by content): an answer equal to the last one makes no object and the run reports unchanged. A new object starts the Silver load of the industrial complexes. No Spark.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from its own bounds: two bulk requests (the notice list 13.5 MB measured 2026-11-09 in a few seconds, the complex list 1,473 rows) and about four detail requests, two seconds apart, plus one ledger read and the 412 KB profile workbook: under a minute, inside the 15-minute limit. The command refuses a run of more than eight requests (its DEFAULT_MAX_REQUESTS) before the first.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: The provider changes its complex list and notices on no fixed day (endpoint catalog expected_cadence irregular for ILIS); that the job runs and finishes is its done expectation (root ADR-0480 §1).

assets.title: 산업단지 주소 근거 받기
assets.description: 산업입지정보시스템(ILIS)의 산업단지 목록과 고시 목록을 한 번씩, 목록에 없는 단지의 상세를 하나씩 매일 받아 Bronze(industrylandorkr__industrial_complex_list·_notice·_detail)에 그대로 쌓는다. 같은 답은 새 객체를 만들지 않는다. 산업단지 Silver 의 주소 해석 근거다(루트 ADR-0033).

assets.title: 산업단지 기본 정보
assets.description: 저장소에 변환 실행 경로가 있다. 운영 적재량·최신 성공 여부는 실행 원장에서 확인한다.

dependencies.description: ILIS 목록·고시·상세는 산업단지 주소 해석의 근거이다. 프로필 본문은 브이월드에서 온다.
산업단지 프로필 원본을 변환하며 시군구 경계의 DBF를 주소 행정구역 판정에 사용한다.
